name: Mononeuritis Multiplex
definition: Asymmetric multifocal neuropathy caused by sequential injury of individual peripheral nerves, often related to vasculitis, diabetes, infection or systemic inflammatory disease.

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostics localize lesions; inflammatory, infectious and vasculitic workup is cause-directed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Urgent neurology/rheumatology assessment when vasculitis suspected
amber: Treatment depends on the underlying cause and may require immunosuppression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/Rakta neuropathic phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Asymmetric multifocal neuropathy caused by sequential injury of individual peripheral nerves, often related to vasculitis, diabetes, infection or systemic inflammatory disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
